sentences.en: Management will have all employees vote at the upcoming meeting.
sentences.zh: 管理层将在即将举行的会议上让所有员工投票。

sentences.en: How are you going to vote in the upcoming election?
sentences.zh: 你打算如何在即将到来的选举中投票？

sentences.en: Miroslav was really excited about his upcoming excursion to Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 米罗斯拉夫对自己即将前往越南的旅行非常兴奋。

senses.zh: 即将来到的，即将出现的,即将到来
